name: Fragment — Water Treatment Sensor Data
author: Water Treatment Monitoring System
description: Sensor readings from the Gray Zone water supply showing a compound that the system cannot identify. The compound appears for 4 hours every 11 days on a precise schedule. It is not harmful. Chemical analysis returns: "STRUCTURE: [UNRESOLVABLE]. ORIGIN: [UNRESOLVABLE]. RECOMMENDATION: [NO DATA]."
story_hooks: Why does it appear on a precise 11-day schedule?
Who or what is introducing it?
